items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: His brother died one day, and he died the next! The two of them were gone.

ctx.x: His brother died one day, and he died the next! The two of them were gone. That's it. That was it. Yes, both of them died of the same thing within one day of each other.
And at that point you decided more or less to pack up and put your horn away?
